metadata: Collegium ( ancient Rome ) A collegium ( plural collegia , gathered together English college ) was any association in ancient Rome with legal personality . Such associations had various functions . Collegia could function as guilds , social clubs , or burial societies in practice , in ancient Rome , they sometimes became organized bodies of local businessmen even criminals , who ran mercantilecriminal activities in given urban region , or rione . The organization of collegium was often modeled on that of civic governing bodies , Senate of Rome being epitome . metadata: The McLaren MP4-31 was Formula One racing car designed by McLaren to compete in 2016 Formula One season . The car was driven by World Drivers Champion Fernando Alonso World Champion Jenson Button , reserve driver Stoffel Vandoorne , who replaced Alonso at following Spaniards accident earlier , following much debate over drivers future . After race , Alonso had also left his future with team open , made it clear day later that he intended to end his career with team , writing No one should have any doubt that I have three years with McLaren my career in F1 will end with this team , hopefully winning everything . About his comments on team radio he said We keep working hard . We all want to win with new tyres front wing . The car was damaged with big hole in front floor , this caused loss of downforce at front rear . Alonso finished seventh two places ahead of teammate Vandoorne , his average lap time was 0.521 seconds quicker . Alonso would describe this race one of best races of my life .

metadata: A snap pizzicato, first specified by Gustav Mahler, often called Bartk pizzicato since Bla Bartk was first to use technique extensively, requires player to pull string away from fingerboard so that when it is released it rebounds with force onto fingerboard, yielding sharp, percussive snapping sound. Examples can be found in Bartks 44 Duos (No. 42, Arabian Song) Solo Sonata for violin.

subject: William Lassell
metadata: The discovery was made on October 10 , 1846 , by English astronomer William Lassell . It is only large moon in Solar System with retrograde orbit , orbit in direction opposite to its planets rotation . At in diameter , contributing to tenuous nitrogen atmosphere less than 170,000 pressure of Earths atmosphere at sea level . It is second-largest planetary moon in relation to its primary , after Earths moon . Triton was discovered by British astronomer William Lassell on October 10 , 1846 , just 17 days after discovery of Neptune . He discovered Triton with his self-built , 61 cm telescope . A brewer by trade , Lassell began making mirrors for his amateur telescope in 1820 . When John Herschel received news of Neptunes discovery , he wrote to Lassell suggesting he search for possible moons . Lassell did so discovered Triton eight days Triton Hopper Triton Hopper is proposed NASA lander to Triton , largest moon of Neptune .

subject: Pausanius
metadata: Pausanius Description of Greece Temple of Zeus , Olympia The Temple of Zeus at Olympia was ancient Greek temple in Olympia , Greece , dedicated to god Zeus . The temple , built in second quarter of fifth piece together . Wood was shaped by carving , steam treatment , lathe , furniture is known to have been decorated with ivory , tortoise shell , glass , gold or other precious materials . The modern word throne is derived from ancient Greek thronos ( Greek singular ) , which was seat designated for deities or individuals of high status or honor . The colossal chryselephantine statue of Zeus at Olympia , constructed by Phidias lost in antiquity , featured god Zeus seated on elaborate throne , which was decorated with gold , precious stones , ebony ivory , according to Pausanias . Other Greek seats included which survives in copies , was said by Pliny to be greatest statue in world . The most famous works of Classical period for contemporaries were colossal Statue of Zeus at Olympia Statue of Athena Parthenos in Parthenon . Both were chryselephantine executed by Phidias or under his direction , are now lost , although smaller copies ( in other materials ) good descriptions of both still exist .
